name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v1.9.11 — Modal and toast UX overhaul. New toast system: bottom-right stack (queue ≤3), distinct auto-dismiss timers per type, screen-reader live region. All 18 modal dialogs: focus trap, body scroll lock, ARIA role/aria-modal/aria-labelledby, opt-in backdrop dismiss for read-only/selection/form modals, no-escape guard for blocking modals. Stack-aware Escape handler. Polish: ring-input style for sprint goal and retro note textareas, equal-width action buttons in modal footers, color hierarchy refresh for destructive-with-restore operations. No schema changes. See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
